name: Atlas CRM
oneLiner: A lightweight CRM for small teams that live in WhatsApp — every inquiry, one inbox, zero spreadsheets.
problem: Inquiries land everywhere — WhatsApp, Instagram DMs, a contact form, a note scribbled at the front desk — and nobody owns the follow-up. Leads go cold because they're scattered, not because they were weak.
solution: Atlas pulls every conversation into one inbox, tags each inquiry as it lands, and flags who needs a follow-up and when. No new app to learn — if your team can use WhatsApp, they can run the pipeline.

features.title: Unified inbox
features.text: WhatsApp, Instagram and web inquiries land in one place — no more checking four apps to find the message that matters.

features.title: Pipeline stages, not spreadsheets
features.text: Move a lead from New to Quoted to Won with a click. See exactly where every deal sits without opening a single formula.

features.title: Follow-up reminders
features.text: Atlas flags inquiries that have gone quiet for 24 hours, so a slow reply never quietly costs you a sale.

features.title: Built for small teams
features.text: No seat limits designed to upsell you, no enterprise onboarding call. Add your whole team for less than one lost lead.

caseStudy.story: A real-estate team was juggling inquiries across WhatsApp, a web form, and a shared notebook. Atlas gave them one inbox and automatic follow-up flags — no missed inquiries, no more sticky notes on a monitor.

name: Bookably
oneLiner: Simple appointment booking for clinics — patients book in seconds, your front desk breathes again.
problem: Phone-based booking means a ringing line, a double-booked slot, and a front desk spending half the day playing scheduling Tetris instead of greeting patients.
solution: Bookably gives patients a simple, mobile-first booking page that reads real-time availability — no phone tag, no overlaps, and a calendar your staff can finally trust.

features.title: Real-time availability
features.text: Patients see actual open slots, not a guess — double-bookings stop being a weekly apology.

features.title: Automated reminders
features.text: SMS and WhatsApp reminders cut no-shows before they cost you a slot someone else needed.

features.title: Front-desk dashboard
features.text: One daily view of every booking, reschedule and cancellation — no flipping between a paper diary and three tabs.

features.title: Multi-provider scheduling
features.text: Each practitioner gets their own calendar and rules, so a clinic with five doctors runs as smoothly as one with one.

caseStudy.story: An SME clinic piloted Bookably to replace phone-tag scheduling at the front desk. Appointments now book themselves against live availability, freeing staff to focus on patients instead of the phone.

name: LaunchKit
oneLiner: Conversion-tested landing page blocks that let us ship campaign pages in a day, not a month.
problem: Every new campaign shouldn't mean rebuilding a page from scratch. Custom builds are slow, and generic page builders produce pages that look like every other page builder.
solution: LaunchKit is our internal library of conversion-tested blocks — hero, offer, proof, capture — that snap together into a page that's live the same day a campaign is approved, without looking off-the-shelf.

features.title: Pre-tested block library
features.text: Every hero, offer and capture block has already been split-tested on real traffic — no guessing which layout converts.

features.title: Same-day assembly
features.text: Approve the copy in the morning, get a live page by the afternoon — campaigns stop waiting on a build queue.

features.title: On-brand, not off-the-shelf
features.text: Blocks are styled to your brand system, not a generic theme — nobody mistakes it for a template.

features.title: Built-in tracking
features.text: Every block ships with conversion tracking wired in, so day one of a campaign already has usable data.

caseStudy.metricLabel: faster page turnaround during campaign season
caseStudy.story: A retail e-commerce brand needed five new campaign pages for a seasonal sale. LaunchKit's blocks meant all five shipped in two days, tested and ready before the sale even opened.
